title: 第6章 你怎么这么快？
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
不知过了多久。

    脚下突然触及实地。

    伊森身体微微一晃，迅速稳住重心，睁开眼。

    入目是一片雾气弥漫的陌生林地。

    参天古木遮天蔽日，枝干扭曲缠绕，浓密的枝叶交织成一张巨大的网，将阳光切割成细碎的光斑，零散地洒在覆盖着腐叶的地面上。

    空气中弥漫着潮湿的腐殖味和不知名花草的怪异香气，耳边传来细碎的虫鸣，却看不到任何生灵的踪迹。

    更诡异的是，周围的景象仿佛在无声地扭曲。

    刚才还在左侧的古树，眨眼间便出现在了身后；脚下的小径明明朝着前方延伸，走了几步却发现又回到了原点；甚至连光线的方向都在不断变化，时而从上方洒落，时而从侧面穿透，让人根本无法判断方位。

    “乱向幻境？”伊森挑了挑眉，低声自语，“方向是乱的？嘿，一般人还真不好处理这种东西，还好我有挂。”

    无需思考，无需参照，东南西北四个方位如同本能般清晰呈现。

    伊森嘴角勾起一丝弧度。

    他没有犹豫，抬脚朝一个方向走去。

    沿途的雾气越来越浓，古木的枝干扭曲得更加诡异，甚至有几棵树的树干上浮现出模糊的人脸轮廓，嘴巴张合，发出细碎的呓语。

    伊森看都不看。

    没多久，眼前的雾气骤然消散。

    扭曲的林地消失了，参天古木消失了，那些诡异的人脸和呓语也统统消失了。

    光芒散去，触感回归。

    伊森脚踩着冰冷、刻满黯淡符文的黑色石板地面，眼前的景象清晰起来。

    巨大的穹顶之下，是广阔的空间。

    中心矗立着一个巨大的、由纯净水晶构筑的法阵基座。

    法阵核心悬浮着一团缓缓旋转的氤氲雾气，呈现出一种非蓝非紫的神秘光晕。

    伊森双脚落在那冰冷的符文地面上时，之前那个说话的人影手中那杯散发着清冽植物香气的热茶，正平稳地悬浮在几只灵活的触腕之间。

    那只拿着杯子的触腕在伊森身形完全清晰的瞬间，猛地一僵！

    “噗嗤！”

    茶杯里的热茶因触腕主人那难以想象的剧烈震动，泼洒出大半。

    滚烫的淡绿色液体浇在袍子上，发出轻微的“滋滋”声，腾起一小片白雾，顺着墨绿布料流淌滴落在地，碎成细小的水珠。

    那只失态的触腕像被烫到似的，嗖一下缩回袍子深处。
content_en:
I don’t know how much time passed.

    My feet suddenly hit the ground.

    Ethan swayed slightly, quickly stabilized his center of gravity, and opened his eyes.

    What you see is an unfamiliar woodland filled with mist.

    Towering ancient trees block out the sky and the sun, their branches are twisted and twisted, and the dense branches and leaves are intertwined into a huge net, cutting the sunlight into fine spots, which are scattered on the ground covered with rotten leaves.

    The air was filled with the humid smell of humus and the strange aroma of unknown flowers and plants, and the faint chirping of insects could be heard in the ears, but there was no trace of any living creatures.

    What's even weirder is that the surrounding scene seems to be distorting silently.

    The ancient tree that was on the left just now appeared behind me in the blink of an eye; the path under my feet clearly extended forward, but after taking a few steps, I found that I had returned to the starting point; even the direction of the light was constantly changing, sometimes falling from above, sometimes penetrating from the side, making it impossible to judge the direction.

    "Towards the illusion?" Ethan raised his eyebrows and whispered to himself, "The direction is chaotic? Hey, it's really hard for most people to deal with this kind of thing, but fortunately I'm safe."

    There is no need to think or refer to it, the four directions of southeast, northwest and northwest are clearly presented as instinctively.

    The corner of Ethan's mouth curled up.

    He didn't hesitate and walked in one direction.

    The fog along the way became thicker and thicker, and the branches of the ancient trees became more and more weird. There were even vague outlines of human faces appearing on the trunks of several trees, with their mouths opening and closing, and whispering.

    Ethan didn't even look at it.

    Not long after, the fog in front of my eyes suddenly dissipated.

    The twisted forestland disappeared, the towering ancient trees disappeared, and the strange faces and murmurs all disappeared.

    The light fades and the touch returns.

    Ethan's feet stepped on the cold black stone floor covered with dim runes, and the scene in front of him became clear.

    Under the huge dome, there is a vast space.

    In the center stands a huge magic circle base made of pure crystal.

    A slowly rotating mist is suspended in the core of the array, showing a mysterious halo that is neither blue nor purple.

    When Ethan's feet landed on the cold rune ground, the cup of hot tea exuding the refreshing aroma of plants in the hands of the figure who spoke before was floating smoothly between several flexible tentacles.

    The tentacle holding the cup suddenly froze at the moment when Ethan's figure was completely clear!

    "Pfft!"

    Most of the hot tea in the tea cup spilled out due to the unimaginable violent vibration of the owner who touched his wrist.

    The hot light green liquid was poured on the robe, making a slight "sizzling" sound, and a small piece of white mist rose up, dripping down the dark green cloth and falling to the ground, breaking into tiny water droplets.

    The awkward tentacle retracted deep into the robe with a swish, as if it had been burned.
title_en: Chapter 6 Why are you so fast?
